description: 彼得罗夫防御 C42 — e线开放后的战术得子

intro.popup_en:
Open Files, Practice 8: Tactics on the Open e-File
After the central exchanges in the Petrov Defense, the e-file is fully open. Re1 claims it with tempo and can combine with a pin to win material if Black is careless.
intro.popup:
e线开放战术 练习8

彼得罗夫中心兑换后
e线完全打开！

Re1先手占据！
配合钉制战术
对方疏忽就能得子！

outro.popup_en: Summary: Nxe5 and ...Nxe4 clear the e-file; Re1 occupies it first, and ...Bg4 pins Nf3 in reply. The key pattern is an open file combined with a pin: together they create powerful tactical threats.
outro.popup:
e线战术小结
✅ Nxe5/Nxe4：e线打通
✅ Re1先手占e线
✅ Bg4反钉Nf3互动

关键技术：
e线开放→Re1→配合钉制战术
开放线+钉制=强力组合！

moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game.
...e5 begins the sequence that will eventually open the e-file.
Nf3 develops.
...Nf6! The Petrov Defense counterattacks e4 instead of directly defending e5.
moves.popup:
Nf6！彼得罗夫！
黑方反击e4而不守e5

moves.popup_en: Nxe5 captures the pawn on e5 and begins the exchange sequence on the e-file.
moves.popup:
Nxe5白马吃e5！
e线兑换序列开始

moves.popup_en: ...d6 attacks the knight and forces it to move.
Nf3 retreats; White brings the knight back to safety.
...Nxe4! Black captures the knight on e4. The knights have cleared the e-file, which is now fully open.
moves.popup:
Nxe4！黑马吃e4！
e线上的马已消失
e线打开！

moves.popup_en: d4 occupies the center.
...d5 counterattacks in the center.
Bd3 develops and targets h7.
...Nc6 develops a knight.
O-O secures White's king.
...Be7 develops the bishop.
Re1! White claims the open e-file with tempo. The rook controls the file and threatens tactics such as Rxe4.
moves.popup:
Re1！先手占e线！
车来e1，e列全在白方控制！
下步威胁Rxe4等

moves.popup_en: ...Bg4! Black counters by pinning Nf3 and threatening to exchange it with ...Bxf3.
moves.popup:
Bg4！黑方反制！
象到g4钉住Nf3
威胁Bxf3兑换马

moves.popup_en: c3 reinforces White's position.
...O-O secures Black's king.
Nbd2! White sidesteps the pin and supports e4. The knight is no longer exposed to the bishop on g4.
moves.popup:
Nbd2！避开钉制！
马到d2，不被g4象钉住
同时支援e4格

moves.popup_en: ...Nxd2 exchanges knights, trying to remove White's central piece.
moves.popup:
Nxd2！黑马兑换
试图消灭白方中心马

moves.popup_en: Bxd2 recaptures and restores White's central control.
moves.popup:
Bxd2重建
象来d2，中心控制稳固

moves.popup_en: ...f5! Black challenges e4 and tries to establish a knight outpost there to contest the e-file.
moves.popup:
f5！黑方推进！
争夺e4格
试图建立e4据点抗衡e线

moves.popup_en: Rc1! White assigns one rook to the e-file and the other to the c-file. The open-file coordination creates tactical threats: for example, Bxf6, gxf6, and Rxe7 can win material if Black is careless.
moves.popup:
Rc1！白方布置c线！
Re1守e线，Rc1控c线
双车分工，两线施压！

Re1在e线的威胁：
→ Bxf6 gxf6 Rxe7！得质！
→ 开放线上的车配合战术威力巨大！
